g.title: The garage door: remote control commands in, statistics out.
Opens and closes the door; implemented by controller.devm.
Behavior: state machine DoorController
provides async status : MotorStatus (accepts the events)
requires async motor : MotorCmd (sends the events)
requires async alarm : event alarm (sends the events)
provides async cmd : DoorCmd (accepts the events)
requires sync position : door::Position (requires the data)
provides sync cycles : integer (provides the data)
provides async alarm : event alarm (accepts the events)
Encoder of the door leaf.
provides sync position : door::Position (provides the data)
Collects statistics.
requires sync cycles : integer (requires the data)
provides sync report : Diagnostics (provides the data)
Motor control, PWM output and end switches.
Subsystem DriveUnit (has an internal block diagram)
requires async status : MotorStatus (sends the events)
provides async ctrl : MotorCmd (accepts the events)
provides async remote : DoorCmd (accepts the events)
provides sync report : Diagnostics (provides the data)
connect door.motor -> drive.ctrl
connect drive.status -> door.status
connect door.alarm -> buzzer.alarm
connect door.position -> sensor.position
connect diag.cycles -> door.cycles
delegate remote -> door.cmd
delegate report -> diag.report
